name: thanks-steps
description: "What happens next" band: centred eyebrow and heading over three numbered step cards, each with a coloured pill label. Live: #ap-demo-next-steps, the second section of the seven 2026 demo thank-you pages.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading, e.g. What happens next.

title.description: Heading, e.g. Here’s what to expect. Line breaks are kept.

items.description: Step cards, in order. Each: label (pill text, e.g. Step 01), tone (yellow, purple or green — the pill colour), title and body.
